items:
A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding work area is required.

Wear your safety equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, breathing mask, safety glass .. 
 etc.
Isolate the circuit breaker of the pump motor.
Disconnect electric terminals of the pump motor.
The pump must be isolated mechanically by closing delivery and suction valves.
Be sure pump must be completely drainage.
Complete maintenance tool set
Cleaning fluid, Manual puller
Feeler gauge, Dial indicator
Vibrometer, Straight edge, Rags
Check discharge quantity and pressure then , compare it with the setting valve
Check gland leakage
Grease bearing
Check the temperature
Check Alignment between ( Motor pump )
Check bolts fixation, then retighten ( if it is needed )
Check the packing of the gland
Check flanges for leaking.
Check the pump casing against rust and repaint ( if it is needed ).
